body.name: Administrator access restricted
body.description: Elevated permissions are granted narrowly and revoked promptly.
body.detail: Elevated actions are enumerated and enforced at the API boundary.
observations: Restricted: case.action_withdrawn, case.close, case.freeze_request, case.sar_draft, evidence.package.export

Each one has an external consequence — closing a case, exporting evidence, asking a bank to freeze funds, filing a regulatory report. Read and analysis are unrestricted, because an investigator who cannot look at the data cannot investigate.
